newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank shares rise in pre-bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank shares rise in pre-bourse trade.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Commerzbank AG rose above the trend in pre-bourse trade on Friday, lifted by ongoing speculation about further consolidation in the German banking sector.
Volume-leader Commerzbank shares were up 2.70 marks, or 4.33 percent, at 65 marks in electronic IBIS DAX trade, while the IBIS DAX index was up 0.73 percent at 4,352.16 points.
Dealers were speculating that a foreign bank might by interested in Commerzbank, perhaps from Switzerland or the Netherlands.
"This would allow a foreigner a foot into the German market," a dealer said.
